n: A more detailed sky: the nebula gas now has texture, soft dark dust clouds and wispy edges, and its colours blend into each other instead of meeting at hard lines

More in the background: bright stars with spikes, a blinking pulsar, an edge-on and an elliptical galaxy, a moon orbiting the ringed planet, a binary star, faint constellations, a slow space station, meteor showers and near dust drifting past
Permanent upgrades: the gold bar on the Engine screen has a close button and an All button. A gold Permanent upgrades button sits at the top of the Upgrades tab, with a switch to bring the bar back
Windows app: the Collapse button is bigger and labelled, and the little corner window is now a proper pixel panel in the game's style (it was a white box on Windows)
Dimensions: every locked dimension now says how to unlock it, both on its card and in a How to unlock box at the top
New automations start switched off. When you unlock one you get a note, and you turn it on yourself in the Auto tab
Smoother: the new sky pieces are drawn once and reused, and planets you can't see aren't redrawn
Safer: the game now blocks any script or connection that doesn't come from the game itself, and old downloads were removed from the site
